story.title: I am a Puppet
paragraphs_en: I am a puppet. From left to right: •Karagoz: shadow puppet from Turkey •Bangarakkha: leather shadow puppet clown from Karnataka •Pulcinella: glove puppet from Italy •Mr Punch: puppet from England

I have many brothers and sisters. From left to right: •Kalasutri Bahuliye: string puppet from Maharashtra •Opera dei Pupi: string puppet from Italy •Yakshagana Gombeyatta: string puppet from Karnataka •Tarer Putul: string puppet from West Bengal

I have cousins too! Shadow puppets, glove puppets, rod puppets. From left to right: •Wayang Kulit: shadow puppet from Indonesia •Pavakathakali: glove puppets from Kerala •Bunraku: rod puppets from Japan

And I have friends all over the world. Some are fat. Some are tall. Some are round. Some are small. And they are purple, blue, orange, and black. From left to right: •Magarina: muppet from Delhi •Tarer Putul: string puppet from West Bengal •Petroushka: clown puppet from Russia •String puppet from Rajasthan •Life-size puppet from Delhi
Wouldn't you like to have family and friends like mine?
